title: Longest Turbulent Subarray
description: A contiguous subarray is turbulent when each adjacent comparison is strict and the comparison signs alternate between greater-than and less-than. Given `nums`, return the length of the longest turbulent subarray. Input: `nums`. Output: that length.
hints: Sort once or track a compact running state to avoid checking every possible group.
Test duplicates, extreme ordering, and cases with no feasible candidate.
